title: SKU mapping + pricing working sheet (v2) — internal plans → AWS/GCP marketplace
content:
Last updated: 2026-02-18 (SL)

Purpose
- Working sheet used by PMM + Finance + Partnerships + Eng Billing to ensure: (1) marketplace SKUs match internal plan names, (2) metering dimensions map cleanly, (3) minimums/discount guardrails are consistent for AWS & GCP.
- This is NOT final customer-facing pricing. Use as input to the public listing copy + private offer templates.

Assumptions / conventions
- “Hosted” = API (usage-based). “Dedicated” = reserved GPU capacity (contract). “Private” = VPC / on-prem software + support (contract).
- Marketplace public offers should be simple and self-serve (Hosted Pay-as-you-go + optionally Hosted Commit). Dedicated/Private generally via private offers.
- Billing dimensions are designed to be stable across model catalog changes (meter by tokens/units, not by model name).
- Any SKU changes must remain backwards compatible w/ existing marketplace subscribers (see ENG-22111 / billing pipeline).

Key to dimension naming
- Internal meters (canonical):
  - hosted.prompt_tokens
  - hosted.completion_tokens
  - hosted.embedding_units
  - hosted.rerank_units
  - dedicated.gpu_hours (capacity reservation)
  - private.platform_fee (license)
  - addons.compliance_pack
  - addons.audit_log_export
  - addons.observability_retention
  - addons.premium_support

============================================================
TABLE A — SKU mapping (internal → AWS → GCP)
============================================================
Columns:
1) Internal plan name
2) Marketplace SKU (AWS)
3) AWS offer type
4) AWS contract dimensions / metering dimensions
5) Marketplace SKU (GCP)
6) GCP billing dimensions
7) Target segment
8) Minimums / term
9) Discount guardrails
10) Notes (entitlements, provisioning)

| # | Internal plan name | Marketplace SKU (AWS) | AWS offer type | AWS dimensions (contract + metering) | Marketplace SKU (GCP) | GCP billing dimensions | Target segment | Minimums / term | Discount guardrails | Notes |
|---|--------------------|-----------------------|----------------|--------------------------------------|------------------------|------------------------|----------------|------------------|---------------------|-------|
| A1 | Hosted API — Pay-as-you-go | Redwood Inference: Hosted API (PAYG) | Public offer (metered) | Metered: PromptTokens, CompletionTokens, EmbeddingUnits, RerankUnits | Redwood Inference: Hosted API (PAYG) | usage.prompt_tokens, usage.completion_tokens, usage.embedding_units, usage.rerank_units | PLG + mid-market procurement-required | No minimum. Month-to-month. | No discounts on public PAYG. Exceptions only via private offer (see A2). | Default console limits apply until entitlement sync confirms subscription. Entitlement propagation can take ~5–20 min; onboarding copy must set expectation. |
| A2 | Hosted API — Commit (spend commit for discounted rates) | Redwood Inference: Hosted API Commit | Private offer (contract) OR Public contract (TBD, AWS portal constraints) | Contract: CommitUSD (monthly) + Metered: PromptTokens, CompletionTokens, EmbeddingUnits, RerankUnits | Redwood Inference: Hosted API Commit | commit.usd (monthly) + usage.* (same as PAYG) | Enterprise + high-usage startups | Suggested min: $10k/mo, 12 months | Standard discount tiers (see Table C). Floor discount requires Finance approval. | Must ensure commit dimension reconciles w/ internal credits/commit ledger (revrec notes). For AWS: confirm whether to implement as contract dimension + usage drawdown vs discounted usage rates. |
| B1 | Dedicated — Reserved capacity (single-tenant GPU pool) | Redwood Dedicated (Reserved Capacity) | Private offer (contract) | Contract: ReservedCapacityUSD (monthly) OR GPUHours (prepaid) | Redwood Dedicated (Reserved Capacity) | commit.usd (monthly) + capacity.gpu_hours (reporting) | Enterprise teams with throughput SLOs, data isolation | Suggested min: $25k/mo, 12 months | Discounts depend on term + prepay. Avoid >25% without CRO + Finance. | Marketplace listing should emphasize: entitlement provisions “Dedicated workspace” + assigns capacity tier. Actual GPU type/region set in SOW/private offer terms. |
| B2 | Dedicated — Burst / overage (on top of reservation) | Redwood Dedicated Burst | Private offer addendum | Metered: BurstGPUHours (or TokenOverageUnits) | Redwood Dedicated Burst | capacity.burst_units | Customers with spiky traffic | No standalone purchase; must attach to B1 | Keep rates at or above PAYG effective rate unless explicitly approved | Requires engineering guardrails so burst doesn’t impact SLOs of base reservation. Need clear console messaging when burst is enabled and how it bills. |
| C1 | Private — VPC deployment (Redwood-managed) | Redwood Private (VPC) | Private offer (contract) | Contract: PrivatePlatformFee (monthly) + optional: PrivateSupportTier | Redwood Private (VPC) | license.platform_fee + support.tier | Regulated workloads, strict network controls | Suggested min: $50k/mo, 12–24 months | Term-based discount only; no “logo discount” without exec approval | Marketplace procurement used as channel; actual deployment timeline is not instant. Listing must set expectation: provisioning is “kickoff + deployment” not immediate self-serve. |
| C2 | Private — On-prem / air-gapped package | Redwood Private (On-Prem) | Private offer (contract) | Contract: PrivatePlatformFee (annual) + PS hours (optional) | Redwood Private (On-Prem) | license.platform_fee_annual + services.ps_hours | Gov/defense, air-gapped regulated | Min: $250k/yr (guidance), 12–36 months | Discount tightly controlled; services line items at standard rates | Requires Legal/Security review per deal; evidence sharing often gated. Ensure SKU wording doesn’t imply “SaaS” when on-prem. |
| D1 | Add-on — Compliance Pack (SOC2/ISO-aligned bundle + DPA support, enhanced evidence access) | Compliance Pack | Private offer add-on (contract dimension) | Contract: CompliancePackUSD (monthly) | Compliance Pack | addons.compliance_pack | Enterprise + regulated | Attach to B/C deals; min $5k/mo | No discount standalone; discount only as part of larger package | Needs careful public wording: we provide documentation + controls; does not “guarantee” customer compliance. Security packet references must match published docs. |
| D2 | Add-on — Audit log export (SIEM streaming / retention extension) | Audit Log Export | Public (metered) OR private offer (TBD) | Metered: AuditLogExportEvents (or GB) | Audit Log Export | addons.audit_log_export_events | Enterprise security teams | If public: no minimum; If private: attach to commit | If public: no discount; If private: bundle discount allowed | Engineering prefers metering by “events” (predictable) vs GB (variable). Confirm feasibility for both AWS & GCP billing semantics. |
| D3 | Add-on — Observability retention (extended metrics/logs retention in Console) | Observability Retention | Public contract add-on (fixed monthly) | Contract: ObsRetentionUSD (monthly) | Observability Retention | addons.observability_retention | Teams needing longer retention for audits | Suggested $2k/mo add-on | Bundle only; avoid discounting below cost | Ensure alignment w/ internal Console retention tiers and actual storage costs. |
| D4 | Add-on — Premium Support (24x7, faster response SLAs) | Premium Support | Private offer (contract) | Contract: SupportTierUSD (monthly) | Premium Support | support.premium_fee | Enterprise + Dedicated/Private | Suggested $5k–$20k/mo based on tier | Discounts only with multi-year terms | Must match Support policy language in marketplace FAQ (response times, coverage). |

Open items / decisions needed (as of 2026-02-18)
- [Finance] Decide if Hosted Commit is implemented as (a) discounted unit rates with monthly commit, or (b) commit drawdown against usage at list rates (revrec + customer expectation impact).
- [Partnerships] AWS constraint check: can we do public contract + metered usage on same listing for A2, or do we force private offers only?
- [Billing/Eng] Confirm final dimension names (case-sensitive) for AWS Metering Service + GCP billing integration (ENG-22111).
- [Security] Final approve language for Compliance Pack so it matches the security packet publication plan (no over-claims).

============================================================
TABLE B — Suggested list pricing placeholders (for modeling only)
============================================================
NOTE: numbers below are placeholders for internal modeling + marketplace form fields. Do not paste into external docs without Finance signoff.

| Meter / dimension | Unit | Placeholder list price | Notes |
|------------------|------|------------------------|-------|
| PromptTokens | 1M tokens | $X.XX / 1M | Billed on input tokens (prompt + system + tool calls). |
| CompletionTokens | 1M tokens | $Y.YY / 1M | Billed on output tokens. Streaming counts the same. |
| EmbeddingUnits | 1k units | $Z.ZZ / 1k | Internal “unit” = 1k tokens embedded (rounded up). |
| RerankUnits | 1k units | $R.RR / 1k | Internal “unit” = 1k docs scored (or equivalent). |
| ReservedCapacityUSD | $/month | $25k+ / mo typical | Dedicated capacity priced as monthly reservation; GPU type/region affects final. |
| PrivatePlatformFee | $/month | $50k+ / mo typical | VPC managed deployment platform fee; excludes customer cloud infra if BYO. |
| CompliancePackUSD | $/month | $5k / mo typical | Add-on; covers evidence access workflows + documentation bundle. |
| SupportTierUSD | $/month | $5k–$20k / mo | Tiered by response times + coverage. |

============================================================
TABLE C — Discount & minimum guardrails (draft)
============================================================
Guardrails (intended for private offers; public offers should not include ad-hoc discounting)

Hosted Commit (A2)
- 12 months:
  - $10k–$25k/mo: up to 10% discount
  - $25k–$75k/mo: up to 15% discount
  - $75k+/mo: up to 20% discount
- 24 months: +5 pts allowed (cap 25%)
- Floor: anything >20% (12 mo) requires CRO + Finance approval.

Dedicated (B1)
- Standard: priced on reservation; discount lever = term/prepay rather than unit discounts
- 12 months: up to 15%
- 24–36 months: up to 25%
- Any deal with effective blended margin < target threshold → Finance review required (Laura).

Private (C1/C2)
- 12 months: up to 10%
- 24 months: up to 15%
- 36 months: up to 20%
- Professional services should not be discounted >10% without exec approval.

Add-ons (D1–D4)
- Prefer bundle pricing; avoid “free add-on” language in offers unless explicitly approved.
- Compliance Pack: discount only if attached to Private (C*) AND term >= 24 months.

============================================================
Notes on procurement + operational implications
============================================================
- Entitlement timing: Support has seen delays; set expectation in onboarding docs and add retry guidance. (Ref: SUP-4821)
- Billing dimension mismatches: must be eliminated prior to launch; customers notice immediately in cost allocation tags. (Ref: SUP-4829)
- Multi-subscription edge case: if customer buys PAYG then later signs private offer, entitlement should “upgrade” not create a new org by default.
- Region/residency: marketplace SKU does not guarantee residency by itself; residency commitments must be configured at org level and reflected in deployment policy.

Change log
- 2026-02-18: Added Dedicated Burst concept (B2) and clarified add-on metering options for Audit Log Export.
- 2026-02-06: Normalized internal meter naming to canonical billing catalog identifiers.
- 2026-01-09: Initial draft table created after kickoff; placeholders only.
